meta.axes: pos=[Unity x,y,z] metres; path_xz/footprint_xz=[x,z]; yaw=atan2(dx,dz) degrees; side relative to input knot direction
meta.road_adapter: load_roads(): raw input knots; no V2 renderer dependency
meta.disabled_policy: replacement audit only, NOT a source-road exclusion list
meta.footprint_scope: all source footprints including excluded/background/removed buildings, conservatively; four core landmarks reserve 12x12m assumption
meta.frontage_scope: env classified fronts, plus raw unclassified fronts outside env crop (camo/posi); explicitly removed OSM ways never used as anchors
meta.ridge_rule: camo inside landmark bounds expanded by 28m + all ridge_* roads; rest retains source piece
meta.junction_policy: all-road noded branches degree>=3 + endpoint-to-interior snap 1m; radius=max half-width+4m; no exceptions
meta.gap_policy: all candidate origins 0.3..1.5m beyond source road edge; whole reservation outside every road and >=0.3m from every building
meta.curb_policy: 0.10m height, 0.15m wide, centre 0.42m beyond edge to obey strict dry-run gap; four-metre reservations trimmed by masks
meta.speed_hump_policy: roadside candidate marker only; road-spanning bump omitted to obey no-road-interior rule
meta.density_denominator: horizontal main+village length, partitioned geometrically at ridge boundary, both sides counted once; no alley/stair denominator dilution
meta.density_policy: compare discrete items AND groups; continuous curb and wire reported separately; geometric rejects never backfilled at unsafe positions
limits: Not V2 output: rerun with exported chains/junction polygons after replacement.
Road heights are proxies, not terrain raycasts; slope from raw road segment.
No animation, mesh, actual facade mounts, sea-side polygon, playtest or import validation.
Mount and core-building footprint assumptions require QA/programming review.
